items.title: M8: capability_release_backfill CLI (dry-run/apply/--digest) + live B-785e/PBP-882 backfill
items.context: Mirror playbook_seed_backfill. Default --dryRun detects under-bound candidates (lineage lacks capabilityReleaseId while a capability release exists for the story); --apply enriches exactly those with capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion/artifactReleaseId; a --digest confirm gate (apply requires the dry-run plan digest). Idempotent, never activates, never infers helped. Then RUN it on the real B-785e artifact release + PBP-882. Ref: exec-plan doc M8 + Follow-up Story.
items.userSees: capability_release_backfill --dryRun: 1 eligible (B-785e/PBP-882); --apply: PBP-882 enriched with capabilityReleaseId; re-run: 0 eligible (idempotent)

happy.desc: capability_release_backfill --dryRun detects under-bound candidates; --apply enriches lineage with capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion/artifactReleaseId. For a story with an artifact release but no capability release, the record-then-bind plan first records the missing capability release (classify from artifact paths) then binds. Live-run binds real B-785e/PBP-882.

edge.desc: --apply requires a --digest matching the dry-run plan; re-running apply is idempotent (0 eligible, no duplicate); a story with no artifact release and no capability release yields 0 eligible.

adversarial.desc: Backfill records only non-authoritative capability releases (authority=non_authoritative, gateEvidence=false), never activates a candidate (status stays candidate), never changes usage.surfacedCount, and never writes a playbook-outcome.

verificationEvidence.note: Record-then-bind migration. Smoke 14/14: CASE A (plan=bind) dry-run detects 1 eligible + stable digest, --apply enriches lineage. CASE B (plan=record-then-bind) dry-run reports the PCR it would record from the artifact release; --apply records the PCR (git add -f + commit, verified tracked) then binds the candidate. Live: node dist/cli.js capability_release_backfill --dryRun --json shows eligibleCount=11, PBP-882 (B-785e) eligible plan=record-then-bind from AR-4e885ed0209e5a32330cdc33.

Edge: --apply requires --digest matching the current dry-run planDigest (wrong and missing both refused); after a full apply a re-run finds 0 eligible (idempotent, no duplicate PCR); record-then-bind is idempotent (PCR now exists, candidate bound); a story with NEITHER a capability NOR an artifact release yields 0 eligible; --storyId scopes the scan. All asserted (14/14 checks).

Adversarial: the migration never activates (status stays 'candidate' post-apply, re-read from disk), never touches usage.surfacedCount (stays 7), never appends a playbook-outcome (no outcomes file). Recorded capability releases stay authority=non_authoritative gateEvidence=false. Conservative: classifier-declines / no-artifact-release stories are NOT made eligible (never invents a binding). Fail-closed write verification enforces all of this in code.

items.title: M6: candidate pending-learning exposure surfaces + exposure records
items.context: Render candidate capability playbooks ONLY under pendingLearning / promotionRecommendations / candidate-inspection, never as active runtime guidance (matchActivePlaybook status===active guard already enforces this; do not weaken it). Write an exposure record per exposure: playbookId, capabilityReleaseId, exposureMode, surface, storyId or sessionId, observedAt.
items.userSees: playbook_promotion_status shows PBP-882 with capabilityRelease after backfill; an exposure record is written on candidate-inspection exposure

happy.desc: A capability candidate (post-backfill PBP-882) surfaces in playbook_promotion_status pendingLearning with its capabilityRelease lineage; when exposed via candidate-inspection an exposure record is written (playbookId, capabilityReleaseId, exposureMode, surface, storyId/sessionId, observedAt).

edge.desc: Exposure only under pendingLearning/promotionRecommendations/candidate-inspection; the candidate never enters active runtime surfacing (matchActivePlaybook status guard, unchanged).

adversarial.desc: Writing an exposure record does not change the candidate status and is not treated as a helped outcome.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke 8/8. HAPPY: playbook_promotion_status pendingLearning surfaces PBP-882 (capability candidate) with its capabilityRelease lineage (JSON row + text render); playbook_trial_run --apply (candidate-exposure path) writes exactly one observable exposure record (playbookId=PBP-882, exposureMode=candidate-inspection, verdictSource=candidate-trial, storyId=B-785e, consumer/surface=session_brief, observedAt), capabilityReleaseId recoverable via lineage; re-apply idempotent (no duplicate).

Smoke 8/8. EDGE: the capability candidate surfaces ONLY under pending-learning/candidate-inspection; it is excluded from active runtime surfacing — matchRuntimePlaybooks returns 0 for the status=candidate playbook and MemoryFreshnessPack.results.playbookIds omits PBP-882; flipping the SAME playbook to status=active surfaces it (matchRuntimePlaybooks length 1 + present in freshness pack), proving the status===active guard (matchActivePlaybook, unchanged) is the gate.

Smoke 8/8. ADVERSARIAL: after the candidate-exposure trial ran, PBP-882 stays status=candidate and usage.surfacedCount/resolvedHits/dismissedHits unchanged (exposure never activates); the exposure record verdict is unknown, isPositiveHelpedPlaybookOutcome=false, and aggregatePlaybookPromotion counts helpedCount=0 / decisiveSamples=0 / unknownCount=1 — an exposure is never a helped outcome.

items.title: M7: structured-outcome recording + evidence-based promotion recommendation commands
items.context: Command surface to record a structured outcome (helped/dismissed/harmful) bound to a concrete exposureMode + structured verdictSource, and a command to emit promotion recommendations when decisiveSamples suffice. DONE-success != helped and the decisiveSamples exclusions are already enforced in learning-store.ts (B-8128 asserts); build the user-facing commands on top without changing those rules.
items.userSees: playbook_outcome_record accepts a structured capability-candidate outcome; playbook_promotion_sweep emits a recommendation only on decisive evidence; DONE-success never counts as helped

happy.desc: A capability candidate flows through the existing playbook_outcome_record (structured verdict + concrete exposureMode) and playbook_promotion_sweep emits an idempotent promotion recommendation when decisiveSamples suffice; never auto-activates.

edge.desc: A done-settlement outcome does not count toward helped/decisiveSamples; helped requires exposureMode != none + a structured verdictSource (existing enforcement, asserted for capability candidates).

adversarial.desc: No path promotes a capability candidate to active without concrete exposure + structured verdict; the invariant is asserted, not weakened.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke 8/8. HAPPY: playbook_outcome_record accepts 3 structured helped outcomes (exposureMode=candidate-inspection, verdictSource=reviewer-confirmation) for capability candidate PBP-882 across 2 context classes; aggregatePlaybookPromotion counts them decisiveSamples=3/helped=3/contextClassCount=2 and evaluatePlaybookPromotion=recommend_activate; playbook_promotion_sweep dry-run EMITS the recommend_activate decision writing nothing (status stays candidate); --apply (with PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED) appends an idempotent recommendation row (2nd apply alreadyApplied=true) and NEVER activates (status stays candidate).

Smoke 8/8. EDGE: a done-settlement helped outcome recorded for PBP-882 is a well-formed row but isPositiveHelpedPlaybookOutcome=false and does NOT increment helped/decisiveSamples (stay 3/3); playbook_outcome_record REFUSES a helped outcome with exposureMode=none (throws helped outcomes require exposureMode other than none) and the refused row is not written — helped requires exposureMode!=none + a structured verdictSource, asserted for the capability candidate.

Smoke 8/8. ADVERSARIAL: with ZERO structured helped outcomes playbook_promotion_sweep returns action=hold with reason insufficient_decisive_samples — never recommend_activate (no concrete exposure + structured verdict = no activation path); and even after a full recommend_activate recommendation (dry-run AND --apply) the on-disk PBP-882 stays status=candidate — the sweep records advisory recommendations only and no path auto-activates the capability candidate; the invariant is asserted, not weakened.
